pr_title: Bluetooth: Mesh: Avoid undefined behavior in bit shift in blob_cli.c
pr_body:
block_size_log can be 0x20 which will shift 1 by 32 bits which will cause undefined behavior. Adding ULL to 1 is an option but this will add little bit more code when debug option is enabled. So simply print the logarithmic value.

Coverity-ID: 316387
Fixes #58951

review_comments:
```
this will add little bit more code when debug option is enabled
```
I really do not like the approach when we try to think for the compiler. Lets it does its work. 
I'd prefer to see in debug logs understandable values rather to go in specification and to look for formula to understand logarithm from what.

This definitely requires uint64_t to do bit shift safely. uint64_t will require %llu specified, which in turns if I understand correctly will require `CONFIG_MINIMAL_LIBC_LL_PRINTF` option enabled to print the value correctly. So I'd prefer to print logarithmic value here.

Up to you, of course. However, not a lot of sense in debug output if it doesn't help you understand instant behavior. I do not see big problem to link debug build with `CONFIG_MINIMAL_LIBC_LL_PRINTF`. Even more, `uint64_t` has been used already in many places and practically it will cost nothing.
For example:
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/main/subsys/bluetooth/mesh/blob_srv.c#L436-L437
